scope: Offline source review of final hosted-artifact packager only; no package execution or actual-artifact verification claimed

checked_gates.provider_association: Exact reviewed commit/repository/workflow URLs; completed successful run and corresponding successful Ubuntu job; run attempt and focused artifact name/head association.
checked_gates.zip_integrity: Provider SHA-256 and exact provider byte length required; bounded member count/uncompressed size; canonical safe member paths; duplicate file/encryption/symlink rejection; explicit prefixes.
checked_gates.failed_run_boundary: Failed/pending run or job, failed required step, non-passed focused outcome, failed helper/compiler phase, timeout or unexpected diagnostics cannot produce a passed package.
checked_gates.source_and_named_audits: Owned source inventory and every digest verified from immutable commit; exact reviewed strict checker/policy; exactly one complete 1236 ordered named-axiom block and verification start/end.
checked_gates.compiled_environment: Exact committed runner/helper/driver and immutable headline/inclusion lists; strict JSON/report validation; actual counts compared with receipt instead of native assumptions.
checked_gates.snapshots_and_objects: Compile/audit before-after equality; canonical input digest; complete configured root-state maps including helper directory; all pins and compiler/runner/helper/driver hashes checked; imported path/name/digest closure bound to recorded snapshots.
checked_gates.helper_binary_delivery: Every delivered helper-library member bound to audit snapshot; actual ResearchAudit/EnvironmentAudit.olean bytes mandatory and must match helper-object digest.
checked_gates.claims_receipt_shape: Passed exact-commit receipt with standard axioms, ordered records, owned source hashes and hashed AxiomAudit.lean/axiom-audit.log is compatible with the claims-ledger focused receipt reader.
checked_gates.lossless_delivery: Complete original text bytes retained; deterministic gzip performs immediate byte-equal decompression check; byte-identical members deduplicated with original hashes/lengths; excluded binary identities retained.
checked_gates.publication_boundary: Writes only a new private .local output; no network/compiler/build/Git mutation. Private successful package remains pending independent root/actual-artifact readback.

conditions_for_publication: Keep the supplied metadata and downloaded ZIP immutable during packaging; the packager hashes ZIP bytes and subsequently opens the same file for member reads. Reconfirm the ZIP digest during actual readback.

Independently verify every archive-member mapping against the authenticated ZIP, including deduplicated targets, gzip decompression, original byte lengths/digests and excluded binary inventory after derived files are written.

Add public-safe run/job/artifact metadata sidecars with provenance/projection information and the exact packager source sidecar. The script records their original metadata digests but does not itself emit those sidecars; add them before sealing the public artifact manifest.
Perform public path/credential hygiene review on the actual emitted bytes; this source review cannot certify unseen artifact payloads.
limitations: No actual Linux count, successful run, provider metadata, ZIP contents or output receipt is certified by this code review alone. Separate authenticated artifact intake and post-packaging readback remain required.
